# 电商订单库: 先按范式判定器打分, 再拆表 + sqlite 验证信息可还原
import sqlite3


def closure(attrs, fds):
    res = set(attrs)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for lhs, rhs in fds:
            if lhs <= res and not rhs <= res:
                res |= rhs
                changed = True
    return res


def fmt(s):
    return "".join(sorted(s)) or "-"


def keys_and_nf(attrs, fds):
    attrs = set(attrs)
    lst = sorted(attrs)
    n = len(lst)
    supers = []
    for mask in range(1, 1 << n):
        sub = frozenset(lst[i] for i in range(n) if mask >> i & 1)
        if closure(sub, fds) == attrs:
            supers.append(sub)
    cands = [s for s in supers if not any(o < s for o in supers)]
    prime = set()
    for c in cands:
        prime |= set(c)
    nf2 = nf3 = bcnf = True
    for lhs, rhs in fds:
        if rhs <= lhs:
            continue
        if closure(lhs, fds) != attrs:
            bcnf = False
            if not (set(rhs) - set(lhs)) <= prime:
                nf3 = False
    for c in cands:
        lst2 = sorted(c)
        for mask in range(1, (1 << len(lst2)) - 1):
            sub = frozenset(lst2[i] for i in range(len(lst2)) if mask >> i & 1)
            if closure(sub, fds) - prime:
                nf2 = False
    return sorted(cands, key=lambda s: (len(s), sorted(s))), nf2, nf3, bcnf


def kf(c):
    return "+".join(sorted(c))


print("=== 电商订单库范式自查 + 拆表验证 ===")
print()
print("① 未规范化的宽表 order_flat:")
print("   order_flat(order_id, user_id, user_name, user_email, product_name, product_price, qty)")
attrs = {"order_id", "user_id", "user_name", "user_email", "product_name", "product_price", "qty"}
fds = [
    (frozenset(["order_id"]), frozenset(["user_id"])),
    (frozenset(["user_id"]), frozenset(["user_name", "user_email"])),
    (frozenset(["product_name"]), frozenset(["product_price"])),
    (frozenset(["order_id", "product_name"]), frozenset(["qty"])),
]
cands, nf2, nf3, bcnf = keys_and_nf(attrs, fds)
print("   候选键 = " + "/".join(kf(c) for c in cands))
print("   2NF=%-4s 3NF=%-4s BCNF=%s" % ("YES" if nf2 else "NO", "YES" if nf3 else "NO", "YES" if bcnf else "NO"))
score0 = 40 + 20 * nf2 + 20 * nf3 + 20 * bcnf
print("   范式得分 = %d / 100" % score0)
print("   问题: user_id->user_name 是对候选键的部分依赖(2NF);")
print("         product_name->product_price 是对候选键的部分依赖;")
print("         user_id->user_name 还是传递依赖(order_id->user_id->user_name)")
print("   后果: 修改用户名需改该用户全部订单行 -> 更新异常; 冗余存储 -> 浪费")
print()

print("② 规范化为 4 张表:")
print("   users(user_id PK, user_name, user_email)")
print("   products(product_name PK, product_price)")
print("   orders(order_id PK, user_id FK)")
print("   order_item(order_id, product_name, qty, PK(order_id, product_name))")
parts = [
    ("users", ["user_id"], ["user_name", "user_email"]),
    ("products", ["product_name"], ["product_price"]),
    ("orders", ["order_id"], ["user_id"]),
    ("order_item", ["order_id", "product_name"], ["qty"]),
]
for name, key, rest in parts:
    a = set(key) | set(rest)
    f = [(frozenset(key), frozenset(rest))]
    c, n2, n3, b = keys_and_nf(a, f)
    print("   %-12s 候选键=%-22s 2NF=%-4s 3NF=%-4s BCNF=%s"
          % (name, "/".join(kf(x) for x in c), "YES" if n2 else "NO",
             "YES" if n3 else "NO", "YES" if b else "NO"))
print("   全部满足 BCNF -> 范式得分 = 100 / 100")
print()

con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
cur = con.cursor()
cur.executescript("""
CREATE TABLE users (user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_name TEXT NOT NULL, user_email TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE products (product_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, product_price INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                     FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id));
CREATE TABLE order_item (order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_name TEXT NOT NULL, qty INTEGER NOT NULL,
                         PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_name),
                         FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id),
                         FOREIGN KEY (product_name) REFERENCES products(product_name));
INSERT INTO users VALUES (1,'Zhang','z@x.com'),(2,'Li','l@x.com');
INSERT INTO products VALUES ('Keyboard',200),('Monitor',1200);
INSERT INTO orders VALUES (101,1),(102,2),(103,1);
INSERT INTO order_item VALUES (101,'Keyboard',1),(101,'Monitor',2),(102,'Keyboard',3),(103,'Monitor',1);
""")
print("③ sqlite 实跑: 4 表 JOIN 还原完整订单信息")
print("   %-7s %-8s %-10s %-12s %-5s %s" % ("订单", "用户", "邮箱", "商品", "数量", "单价"))
for r in cur.execute("""
SELECT o.order_id, u.user_name, u.user_email, i.product_name, i.qty, p.product_price
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN order_item i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN products p ON i.product_name = p.product_name
ORDER BY o.order_id, i.product_name
"""):
    print("   %-7s %-8s %-10s %-12s %-5s %s" % r)
n = cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item").fetchone()[0]
total = cur.execute("SELECT SUM(i.qty * p.product_price) FROM order_item i JOIN products p ON i.product_name=p.product_name").fetchone()[0]
print("   明细行数 = %d, 全库订单金额 = %d" % (n, total))
print()
print("④ 更新异常对照: 用户改名")
cur.execute("UPDATE users SET user_name='ZhangSan' WHERE user_id=1")
changed = cur.execute("SELECT changes()").fetchone()[0]
rows_affected_in_flat = cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id=1").fetchone()[0]
print("   规范化后改 users 表: %d 行" % changed)
print("   若在宽表中: 需改 %d 行 (该用户全部订单)" % rows_affected_in_flat)
print("   一致性: 规范化方案由外键保证; 宽表方案需应用层事务内手动同步")
con.close()
